instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Precision Components Inc. is a medium-sized manufacturer specializing in high-precision metal and electronic components for the automotive supply chain. The company operates in a highly regulated environment due to strict quality control standards required by major global automotive clients.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company has recently implemented Lean manufacturing principles to reduce waste and improve cycle times on existing production lines. They have also invested modestly in upgrading their ERP system.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary goal is to significantly improve operational efficiency by reducing unit cost by 15% over the next three years. We aim to maintain high quality standards while expanding our market share within the specialty component sector.
answers.teamSize: The core R&D and operations team consists of 25 highly skilled engineers and technicians who prioritize stability and reliable execution over rapid, high-risk experimentation.
answers.additionalContext: We face increasing pressure from competitors who are leveraging automation, which threatens our current cost structure and speed to market.

opportunities.title: Supply Chain Automation Pilot
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a small-scale robotic system for quality inspection in the finishing phase can reduce manual error rates and labor costs incrementally.

first_actions: Identify 3 high-error processes for automation targeting Year 1 Q2.
Conduct a feasibility study on existing component handling equipment.
resources_needed: Contract for pilot system integration consultation
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in scrap rate by 5% within the first year.
milestones: Pilot system operational and data collected (Month 9)

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Predictive Maintenance System
opportunities.rationale: Developing a machine learning model to predict equipment failure in CNC machines can drastically reduce unplanned downtime, a major source of efficiency loss.

first_actions: Gather 3 years of historical sensor data for key machinery.
Hire/contract a specialized data science consultant.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unplanned maintenance events by 30%.

opportunities.title: Process Streamlining Audit
opportunities.rationale: Conduct a comprehensive audit of the current production workflow to eliminate redundant steps and bottlenecks that consume significant labor time.

first_actions: Map out end-to-end manufacturing process using value stream mapping (VSM).
Identify three non-value-added processes for immediate elimination.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in total manufacturing lead time by 10%.
milestones: Implementation of first three process improvements (Month 9)

next_steps.action: Form a cross-functional Efficiency Task Force (Ops, Engineering, Finance) to define the top 3 process bottlenecks.
Conduct initial vendor vetting for IoT/sensor technology compatible with existing machinery.
Develop a detailed ROI model comparing the incremental automation pilot vs. internal labor cost savings.

key_weaknesses: Outdated legacy ERP system limiting real-time inventory visibility.
High dependency on specialized, hard-to-retain technical talent.
Inefficient manual quality control checkpoints leading to high scrap rates.
Slow communication flow between R&D and Production teams.
